ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels to 60% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe features a large, contiguous high-intensity region on the distal half containing small, low-intensity focal spots. Left lobe displays fragmented, linear high-intensity mottling across the outer two-thirds. Proximal regions and central peduncle area are predominantly low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp, V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays extreme, high-amplitude serration with jagged peak-to-valley transitions on the distal half. Left lobe trailing edge is relatively smoother with low-amplitude, undulating variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature fitted to the outer edges of both lobes, tapering to narrow, acute points at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct 'bullseye' pattern (white ring around a dark center) on the distal field of the right lobe, accompanied by a cluster of smaller, high-contrast circular spots.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel, low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the high-intensity mottled regions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular tissue loss and heavy serration on the trailing edge of the right lobe; prominent circular lesion/scar on the distal right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of a singular 'target' scar in the upper-right quadrant and extreme distal trailing edge fragmentation on the right lobe.
